sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 482.6 x 311.2 x 88.9 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured
Crown XTi 4002 product page (opened 2026-11-12): 3.5 in x 19 in x 12.25 in (2U), 18.5 lb (8.4 kg), IEC power connector 15 A. The plan size 482.6 x 311.2 x 88.9 mm is that page in mm.

Crown XTi2 Series operation manual (downloaded, read as text on 2026-11-12), back panel of the XTi 1002 / 2002 / 4002: two 3-pin XLR inputs (one per channel), two 3-pin XLR link outputs, two 4-pole speakON output connectors (channel 1 connector wired for both channels), one pair of binding post outputs per channel, a Type B USB connector (HiQnet), the AC power connector with a cord clip. The IEC inlet type is not named (15 A: a C20 in practice): it is modelled as iec-c14 and listed as assumed in the plan row (assumedConnectors), like the Neumann KH 120 II. Modelled: 2 XLR inputs, 2 speakON outputs, the inlet; the XLR link outputs, binding posts and USB-B are drawn only (the amplifier template routes each input to every speaker output when ports outnumber them, so only the 1:1 set is modelled).

Port and control positions are GUESSES. build: rack-box v3b (front vent block, LCD window, ear handles); the vents, window and handles are ESTIMATES drawn from the usual layout of this amplifier class (no photo or drawing opened). The size d includes the 20 mm handles. build.projection: our own generic artwork; no photo, no logo, no lettering.
